notes: The four intro pages are back, and they swipe
Cards and messages arrive one by one instead of the whole screen cross-fading
You can tell which tab you are on again, and the plus button no longer crowds the bar
LIVE only shows when something is actually playing or someone is listening
Sign in fits on one screen, so Create account is no longer below the fold
The app icon is fixed - it was being cropped away by Android before it ever drew
The plus button in the navigation is a whole circle again, not a clipped one
Sign in and Create account are separate now, and signing in no longer asks you to build a profile you already have
Password fields have a show/hide button
The session's bottom bar swipes up for change lobby and games, and light/dark now fades instead of snapping
A new look throughout: deeper background, glass navigation, and one colour reserved for what is live
Create a session from the button in the middle of the navigation bar
Mic, deafen and mute-one-person are on the session screen itself, not buried in a sheet
Direct messages have their own place in the navigation, with an unread count
Server moved to Mumbai — roughly six times faster than before
You will need to sign in again: this is a new database
Settings can now check for and install a new app build
Settings has a Software update section — apply an update you turned down earlier
A strip at the top of the app shows when you are on an older version
Update notes now cover every patch you skipped, not just the newest
The update sheet rises from the bottom and follows light and dark
Navigation fades everywhere; only a Session slides up
Returning to a screen animates properly instead of snapping
Direct messages: inbox, threads and composer
